C1401.title: Beanstalk DAO Governance Attack Incident
C1401.summary: In 2022, Beanstalk DAO suffered a governance attack where the attacker used flash loans to acquire a large amount of governance tokens, gained a supermajority voting power, and then executed malicious proposals through an emergency commit function, stealing approximately $181 million in funds. The attack involved two proposals: BIP18 as a trojan proposal and BIP19 as a distraction proposal.
